Title: Authorize.Net - BVA: Partial Expiry Year (1-Digit) Shows Length Error; Full 2-Digit Expired Year Shows Expiry Error (Validation-Only)
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
- Logged in as registered user; fresh cart with >=1 item
- Authorize.Net inline form rendered on /cart (AllowCartPayment=true, VCST-5162)
- PURPOSE: BVA on the year-field validators introduced by PR #2309 (bank-card-form.vue change #3). The year has TWO yup rules: a .length(2) rule (length) and a .test('not-expired') rule that is only evaluated when year.length === 2. A 1-digit year fails the .length(2) rule and shows a LENGTH error ('Year must be exactly 2 characters') — it never reaches the not-expired check. A full 2-digit past year shows the EXPIRY error ('Expiration date must be in the future'). A full 2-digit future year is valid. This separates the length boundary from the expiry boundary; PAY-AN-019 only covers fully-entered years. Live-verified 2026-06-15 (VCST-5162 lifecycle Phase 5).
- VALIDATION-ONLY case: do NOT click 'Place order' at any point
